spec.headline: “Isolation does not remove market risk, but it restricts the boundary of failure.”

blocks.text: Structural segregation bounds shortfalls strictly to the originating position.
When debt mutualizes, insolvency migrates across shared balances.

focal.reason: Supporting caption elaborating the systemic mechanics of structural segregation.

defects.issue: Severe bottom and right canvas imbalance
defects.location: Lower 50% and right 40% of the canvas
defects.reason: All content is clustered tightly into the top-left quadrant, leaving over half the frame entirely vacant without architectural purpose or grounding.
defects.fix: Center the text block vertically by increasing the top offset from 120px to 260px, and widen the text column from 800px to 920px to utilize the horizontal canvas.

defects.issue: Inverted hierarchy against intended focal element
defects.location: Body copy block #0 ('Structural segregation bounds shortfalls...')
defects.reason: The headline quote dominates the visual field in weight and scale, reducing the intended focal element to muted, low-contrast body copy.
defects.fix: Increase block #0 font size to 32px with 100% white opacity, and reduce the headline scale from 56px to 44px to restore intended emphasis.

defects.issue: Flush opening quotation mark disrupts optical margin
defects.reason: The curved opening quote mark sits flush with the text container, making the primary text column appear unaligned relative to the subhead and body copy beneath it.
defects.fix: Enable hanging punctuation or apply a negative left margin (-14px) to the opening quotation mark so the capital 'I' aligns with the subhead.
